headword: {重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつく
reading: じゅうばこのすみをつつく
gloss: to nitpick; to split hairs; to find fault with trivial details

definitions.gloss: to nitpick; to split hairs; to find fault with trivial details
definitions.explanation: To obsessively point out minor, insignificant flaws or details. Used critically of someone who focuses on trivialities instead of the big picture.

examples.japanese: {重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつくような⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧はやめて⟦くれ→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He always nitpicks, so meetings drag on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来|でき}→出来：11763_deki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつくような⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧。
examples.english: The overall work is good, but it's frustrating to receive nothing but nitpicking criticism.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{重箱|じゅうばこ}→重箱：22377_juubako⟧ (tiered lacquer box used for food) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + ⟦{隅|すみ}→隅：01625_sumi⟧ (corner) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦つつく→つつく：10373_tsutsuku⟧ (to poke). Literally "to poke at the corners of a tiered box" — picking at the tiny bits of food stuck in the corners.
Also seen as ⟦{重箱|じゅうばこ}→重箱：22377_juubako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{隅|すみ}→隅：01625_sumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ほじくる (using ほじくる "to dig out" instead of ⟦つつく→つつく：10373_tsutsuku⟧).

USAGE:
Almost always used critically. The phrase {重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつくような is a common modifier for words like ⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧ (criticism), ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧ (question), or ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧ (argument).
